A '''store selling video monitors''' was located on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]]. [[Aurebesh]] lettering over the entrance read "SCREENS." Hand painted signs written in [[Futhork]] were displayed outside the shop, with a [[Color|pink]] sign saying "MADE TO <small>''[obscured]''</small>" and a blue one saying "WHILE YOU WAIT".

At one point, [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] was confronted by [[Nurchi]] outside the store, who wanted Andor to pay back his deposit; however, Andor said he was unable to pay him back at the moment. Andor was also cornered by [[Vetch]], who had been brought in to serve as Nurchi's "muscle." Andor accused Vetch of selling him out to Nurchi, but before he walked away,he promised to pay back his deposit.<ref name="Kassa" />
